Given the curve r(t)=⟨t2−2t,t2,8t−2t2⟩, find the point at which the tangent to the curve is parallel to the vector ⟨1,2,0⟩.

a
 (−1,1,6)
b
 (0,0,0) and (0,4,8)
c
 (3,1,−10) and (−1,1,6)
d
 (3,1,−10)
e
(0,4,8)
